materiality: Corrects DeepSeek V4.1 VL image-token sliding-window attention from inherited widened/bidirectional visibility to the official causal-window contract.
Affects both full-image and continuation prefill and therefore can change multimodal outputs even when model weights and tokenizer bytes are unchanged.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports 30 targeted tests passed on GB200 with 3 gated-builder tests deselected.
Upstream explicitly did not claim full-model VL accuracy, generation-length evaluation, or AMD runtime validation.
requiredEvidence: Bind the exact vLLM source revision and executed wheel/container digest, CUDA/driver/compiler/device identity, and the exact governed DeepSeek V4.1 model, tokenizer, processor, chat-template and encoding revisions.

Construct deterministic independent causal-window fixtures covering text-only, image spans, boundary queries, full prefill and continuation prefill with compression ratios 0, 1 and 2; assert that no future image token or out-of-window predecessor is visible.
Compare paged and gathered sparse-window indices against an independent reference implementation and prove identical causal positions at image-span starts, interiors, ends and chunk boundaries.

Run fixed-seed end-to-end text+image generation parity/quality checks against the official model contract and the incumbent admitted runtime; distinguish intentional correction from unrelated output drift.

Exercise CUDA-graph and eager execution, prefix reuse, mixed text/image batches, cancellation, worker restart and malformed multimodal metadata; unsupported hardware or unexecuted paths remain UNAVAILABLE or UNQUALIFIED, never PASS.

Preserve explicit rollback to the previous exact admitted runtime. No production route, provider, model default, Hugging Face projection or public capability claim changes before normal qualification gates pass.

materiality: Upstream identified a catastrophic DeepSeek V4 ROCm accuracy regression where GSM8K exact-match fell to near zero under an AITER/FP8 configuration.
The merged repair reverts two quantized-linear changes and upstream reports restored GSM8K exact-match around 0.95, making this a correctness boundary rather than routine backend churn.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports the repaired DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP8 ROCm/AITER configuration restored GSM8K accuracy in its measured setup.
Those upstream measurements are not SZL receipts and do not establish correctness for other AMD generations, precisions, kernels, concurrency levels or SZL runtime composition.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM source/build bytes, exact DeepSeek V4 model/tokenizer/encoding source, AITER revision, ROCm/driver/compiler identities, accelerator SKU/topology and every quantization/KV-cache/runtime flag used in the executed lane.

Add a deterministic low-level reference test that detects the preshuffled/row-major FP8 weight-layout or scale-layout failure mode independently of GSM8K and fails on the known-bad predecessor when that predecessor is executable.

Run fixed-seed model correctness on the supported ROCm lane with an accuracy sentinel large enough to reject catastrophic collapse, plus token/logit parity probes that localize regressions before aggregate benchmark interpretation.

Exercise AITER enabled/disabled, fused/shared-expert settings actually admitted by SZL, startup/load, warm restart, prefix cache and representative concurrency; configurations not executed remain UNQUALIFIED.
Capture negative controls demonstrating that the guard detects the previously bad selection/layout path rather than merely recording a healthy score from a different backend.
Preserve rollback to the previous exact admitted ROCm runtime and do not infer NVIDIA qualification, production readiness, provider promotion or public benchmark claims from the upstream repair.

materiality: Fixes vLLM selecting a CUTLASS FP8 scaled-matmul backend on A100/sm80 even though that backend is unsupported there, causing model startup/execution failure.
The repair tightens capability admission and falls back to a supported FP8 linear backend, directly affecting an accelerator class already represented in the SZL estate.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports Nemotron-3 GSM8K on A100 no longer fails and selects the Marlin FP8 linear backend.
The five-line upstream source fix does not itself qualify every FP8 model, Ampere topology, CUDA version or fallback backend combination used by SZL.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM wheel/source, CUDA/driver/compiler, A100 SKU/SM capability, exact model/quantization source and the loaded kernel/backend identities in the execution receipt.

Add deterministic capability-selection tests proving CUTLASS FP8 is rejected on unsupported sm80 and the expected supported fallback is selected; include a negative control that fails if unsupported CUTLASS selection is reintroduced.
Prove the same selector still admits CUTLASS FP8 only on architectures where its own capability predicate is true, preventing an A100 repair from silently disabling valid newer-GPU paths.

Run at least one representative SZL FP8 model on real A100 hardware through load, prefill and decode with fixed-seed output/accuracy sanity against the incumbent reference; unavailable A100 hardware is UNAVAILABLE, not PASS.
Exercise fallback absence/failure explicitly so an unsupported or missing alternate kernel fails with a classified error rather than silent precision or backend substitution.
Keep existing runtime defaults and rollback intact until normal accelerator, correctness, provenance and serving gates produce source-bound receipts.

alignmentDependency.note: Runtime candidate evaluation does not close or override the separately reopened A11oy source/projection drift. No candidate may use stale projection state as qualification evidence.
